title: Daily automated story drafts for every Papyrus site, as router configuration
description: The monitoring router gets a monitor-stories task and a daily EventBridge schedule: for each publication it drafts a cited story_draft Proposal for every accepted, not yet drafted, monitored Reference, with one soft review request per publication and run. On by default; monitorStories.enabled false turns a publication off. No fixed cap: bounded by the Lambda's remaining time (shared equally), a model-spend backstop and a filing error. Independent of the knowledge-run stack. Related: PPY-ad264d (auto-accept).
